title: Sustainability Manager
description:
Title: Sustainability Manager

Location: Varginha, Brazil

Reports to: Commodity Director, Switzerland

The Sustainability Manager will lead the implementation of KDP’s responsible sourcing and impact strategies in the company’s coffee supply chain. This means ensuring suppliers comply with our standards on social, environmental, and ethical practices and partnering with suppliers for positive impact aligned to our goals and commitments. This position will play a strategic role in advancing regenerative agriculture and farmer livelihoods, increasing supplier engagement, and supporting due diligence efforts to align with corporate sustainability policies and international regulations. The role will also leverage industry partnerships and frameworks like the Global Coffee Platform (GCP) to assess supplier compliance, promote continuous improvement, and drive alignment with globally recognized sustainability standards. This role will work in close relationships with our Enterprise Sustainability Team.

Responsibilities:

Supplier Engagement & Compliance

  • Communicate and enforce KDP’s responsible sourcing protocols with suppliers across the company’s coffee supply chain.
  • Conduct supplier assessments and manage action plans to close compliance gaps.
  • Monitor compliance with other relevant legislation and internal policies, e.g. deforestation and climate commitments.

Sustainability Projects & Partnerships

  • Lead local sustainability programs in collaboration with relevant implementers, e.g. NGOs, cooperatives, and producer groups, including contract and budget management, field visits and impact reporting.
  • Identify and scale projects aligned with KDP’s global sustainability goals.
  • General support to administer the broader coffee investment portfolio

Traceability & Due Diligence

  • Evaluate the performance of responsible sourcing partner programs and ensure continuous improvement in service of KDP’s goals
  • Evaluate potential new Responsible Sourcing programs
  • Support broader traceability and transparency initiatives across coffee supply chains
  • Ensure proper documentation and data collection to meet legal and corporate due diligence requirements.

Internal Collaboration & Reporting

  • Collaborate closely with KDP’s global procurement and sustainability teams.
  • Provide regular reporting on sustainability KPIs and project impact, as well as managing coffee-related disclosures
  • Engage in cross-functional initiatives that drive ESG progress and origin resilience.
  • Support the company to meet customer requests for traceability and impact data

Requirements:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Agronomy, Environmental Sciences, Business, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in sustainability, procurement, or supply chain roles in the agri-food or coffee sector.
  • Experience working with certification standards, project management and impact assessment is highly desirable.
  • Confident using MS Applications (Word, PowerPoint and Excel)

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of sustainability frameworks and supply chain risk.
  • Ability to manage multi-stakeholder projects in rural or agricultural contexts.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills across a variety of internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to producing areas (15%-20%).

Please apply directly through the link and attach a cover letter outlining your interest in this role at KDP Brasil.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

Quem somos

A Busbud é um grupo líder global em mobilidade focado em viagens interurbanas terrestres, com a missão de transformar a forma como as pessoas se conectam em todo o mundo. O grupo opera um mercado B2C focado na reserva de viagens interurbanas terrestres (ônibus, trem, caronas compartilhadas e muito mais), utilizado por mais de 100 milhões de viajantes em mais de 3 milhões de rotas em mais de 80 países. A empresa também oferece software SaaS B2B vertical que impulsiona os negócios de centenas de operadores de viagens terrestres em todo o mundo. Capacitamos os viajantes a descobrir novos destinos, construir conexões e experimentar o mundo — tudo isso enquanto fazem escolhas ambientalmente conscientes, promovendo um modo de transporte mais sustentável e acessível. Esta função está especificamente focada na Buson, nossa plataforma regional de mobilidade que torna as viagens de ônibus no Brasil mais inteligentes, acessíveis e convenientes.

Será responsável por realizar trocas e cancelamentos de passagens, acompanhar solicitações e oferecer um atendimento multicanal humanizado, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva do cliente.

  • Administrar e acompanhar tickets abertos por passageiros, assegurando a resolução dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes por meio de diversos canais, como telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, entre outros, proporcionando uma experiência eficiente e humanizada.
  • Realizar atendimento personalizado ao cliente de novos produtos, esclarecendo dúvidas, oferecendo suporte e garantindo uma experiência positiva na utilização das soluções oferecidas.

A Busbud está comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todos os funcionários e com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho livre de discriminação e assédio. Todas as decisões de emprego na Busbud são baseadas nas necessidades da empresa, nos requisitos do cargo e nas qualificações individuais, independentemente de raça, cor, religião ou crença, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra condição protegida pelas leis aplicáveis.

Customer Experience Analyst

Who We Are

Busbud is a global leader in ground travel mobility, with a mission to transform the way people connect around the world.

The group operates a B2C marketplace focused on booking intercity ground travel (bus, train, ridesharing, and more), used by over 100 million travelers across more than 3 million routes in over 80 countries.

The company also offers vertical B2B SaaS software that powers the businesses of hundreds of ground travel operators worldwide.

We empower travelers to discover new destinations, build connections, and experience the world, all while making environmentally conscious choices and promoting a more sustainable and accessible mode of transportation.

This role is specifically focused on Buson , our regional mobility platform that makes bus travel in Brazil smarter, more accessible, and more convenient.

We are looking for a professional to support passenger service, ensuring fast and high-quality assistance. This person will be responsible for processing ticket changes and cancellations, managing requests, and providing humanized, multichannel support — contributing to a positive customer experience.

Job Title: Scrum Master – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)

Duration: 10–11 months

Location: LATAM or Europe – Remote

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to lead Agile delivery for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) teams. This role focuses on facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across SFCC implementation and ongoing support initiatives ( Run + Grow ).

The ideal candidate has strong eCommerce domain expertise , can effectively coach cross-functional teams, and ensures alignment with organizational governance, security, and compliance standards.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years in Agile delivery
  • 5+ years as a Scrum Master supporting web/eCommerce teams
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/SFRA) or comparable enterprise eCommerce platforms
  • Proven ability to improve velocity predictability, reduce defect leakage, and manage dependencies
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban , Agile metrics, and scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus, or pragmatic multi-team coordination)
  • Proficiency with:
  • Jira (boards, filters, dashboards)
  • Confluence (documentation)
  • CI/CD awareness (Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Scrum certifications: CSM or PSM I / PSM II
  • Solid eCommerce domain knowledge:
  • Catalog, pricing, promotions
  • Checkout, payments, tax, shipping, returns
  • Order Management Systems (OMS)

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery & Facilitation

  • Lead Agile ceremonies: daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews/demos, retrospectives
  • Partner with Product Owners to prioritize backlogs, refine user stories, and define sprint goals
  • Track sprint health (capacity, velocity, burndown/burnup) and manage scope
  • Identify and remove impediments (dependencies, environments, test data, approvals)
  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies (SFCC, integrations, OMS, payments, SEO/content, analytics)
  • Promote flow efficiency by limiting WIP and reducing blockers

Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting

  • Provide clear, timely status reporting (velocity trends, sprint summaries, risks, mitigations)
  • Facilitate effective demos to showcase business value and gather early feedback
  • Ensure alignment with governance, security, compliance, PCI, accessibility, and change management

Coaching & Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams and stakeholders on Agile and Scrum best practices
  • Facilitate retrospectives with measurable outcomes and follow-through
  • Foster a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and outcome-driven delivery

Project Leadership

  • Manage SFCC B2C implementation, migration, and enhancement projects end-to-end
  • Define scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables aligned with business goals

Planning & Execution

  • Develop project plans, budgets, and resource allocation strategies
  • Monitor progress, manage risks, and ensure quality and timeline adherence

Team Coordination

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, QA, UX/UI teams, and third-party vendors
  • Ensure SFCC best practices across development and integrations

Technical Oversight

  • Understand SFCC B2C architecture and APIs (OCAPI, SCAPI)
  • Support integrations with payment gateways, OMS, CRM, and enterprise systems
  • Work with SFCC Business Manager configurations as needed

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

A Oportunidade

Você atuará em projetos que envolvem desenvolvimento de serviços back-end, infraestrutura cloud e segurança da informação, contribuindo diretamente para a estabilidade e evolução do nosso ecossistema tecnológico.

Seu Dia a Dia Incluirá

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs back-end, garantindo performance, segurança e confiabilidade.

O Que Buscamos

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática em C#, Python e/ou JavaScript/TypeScript, com foco em backend e infraestrutura.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e integração via APIs REST.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e práticas de segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo e resolutivo, com disposição para lidar com desafios técnicos de alta complexidade.

Diferenciais (mas não obrigatórios)

O Que Oferecemos

title: Tech Lead (IA)
description:
Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas referência no setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos tecnologias modernas, arquitetura escalável e foco em experiência do cliente para entregar soluções que otimizam operações logísticas, promovendo produtividade, controle e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.

A Inteligência Artificial é um pilar estratégico da Mobiis para automação de processos logísticos, inteligência operacional e evolução contínua dos produtos.

Resumo da função

O(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial (IA) atuará em um papel híbrido, combinando liderança técnica e execução direta (hands-on) no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA aplicadas aos produtos da Mobiis.

Este profissional será responsável por definir direcionamentos técnicos, garantir qualidade e escalabilidade das soluções, ao mesmo tempo em que participa ativamente do desenvolvimento de algoritmos, modelos e pipelines de IA, assegurando impacto real no negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a arquitetura e as melhores práticas para a construção e integração de agentes autônomos utilizando frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain e LangGraph, visando a automação de processos complexos.
  • Orientar a equipe no desenvolvimento de projetos de scraping automatizado e inteligente, aplicando abordagens avançadas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Supervisionar o pré-processamento, a limpeza e a preparação de dados, além de guiar a equipe em técnicas de feature engineering em datasets estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código, a conformidade com as boas práticas de engenharia de software (Clean Code, SOLID, Design Patterns) e conduzir code reviews.
  • Liderar a implantação de modelos em ambientes produtivos utilizando pipelines em nuvem (Azure), garantindo escalabilidade e robustez.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato técnico entre o time de IA e outras equipes multidisciplinares (arquiteto, design, dev, PO, QA, CSM), alinhando as soluções de IA aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Incentivar a cultura de aprendizado contínuo, reprodutibilidade e documentação detalhada de processos e experimentos

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área correlata.
  • Habilidade para projetar e implementar soluções com fluxos multi-agente e comunicação entre agentes via LLMs.
  • Sólida experiência em projetos de IA/ML, com histórico comprovado de liderança técnica.
  • Proficiência avançada em Python e ampla experiência com diferentes tipos de bancos de dados.
  • Experiência aprofundada com frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch e Scikit-learn).
  • Expertise em fundamentos de IA generativa e no uso de LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face).
  • Conhecimento avançado de bibliotecas de manipulação de dados (Pandas, NumPy) e de scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright).
  • Experiência sólida e prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes (CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Git, arquitetura de APIs REST/GraphQL, e experiência com conceitos de CI/CD e MLOps.
  • Experiência com deploy de modelos ou agentes em ambientes de cloud, utilizando ferramentas como Docker/Kubernetes e monitoramento de desempenho.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidade de liderança, proatividade e capacidade de orientar e motivar a equipe em um ambiente de rápida evolução tecnológica.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal, com habilidade para apresentar soluções técnicas complexas de forma clara a públicos diversos.
  • Visão estratégica e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo a organização e a validação de pipelines de ponta a ponta.

Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em .NET e Angular;
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade, segurança e responsabilidade na implementação de modelos de IA.
  • Garantir a qualidade do seu código com boas práticas;
  • Gostar muito de aprender;
  • Fomentar a troca de conhecimentos;
  • Facilidade para se comunicar - nível técnico e usuário;
  • Sem medo de perguntar. Sem medo de ensinar. Sem medo de apresentar suas ideias;
  • Preocupação com qualidade visual da entrega final;
  • Publicação de aplicativos nas lojas da Apple e Google;

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:

  • Garantir que a aplicação dos produtos esteja em conformidade com especificações técnicas, normas e boas práticas;
  • Apoiar equipes internas e clientes com informações técnicas provenientes das atividades em campo.

Quem você é:

Você dedica tempo para fazer perguntas, definir o problema e tornar o aprendizado uma prioridade e um objetivo. Você reconhece e recompensa os esforços de outras pessoas. Você prepara conteúdos para comunicação de forma impactante.

  • Formação técnica em automação, mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, diagramas e especificações;
  • Conhecimento básico de normas técnicas, padrões de segurança e boas práticas industriais.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam: (Requisitos desejáveis – não mandatórios)

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos no segmento industrial;
  • Familiaridade com atividades de campo, comissionamento de sistemas e acompanhamento de paradas programadas;
  • Noções de levantamento de materiais, componentes e peças em campo;
  • Conhecimento com área explosiva;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Nossa oferta para você: (Lista de benefícios)

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos funcionários e sabemos que, para dar o melhor de si, você deve ter benefícios flexíveis e competitivos para atender às necessidades físicas, mentais, financeiras e sociais, suas e de sua família. Para isso, oferecemos seguro de vida em grupo, assistência médica e odontológica, vale alimentação, PLR anual. Nossos funcionários também podem contar com o apoio de cooperativa de crédito e o programa de apoio ao empregado Emerson Care. Somos empresa cidadã o que nos permite oferecer licença parental remunerada (materna e paterna) diferenciada. Além disso, preocupados com o seu futuro, também oferecemos Plano de Previdência Privada.

Na Emerson, temos o compromisso de incentivar uma cultura onde cada funcionário seja valorizado e respeitado por suas experiências e perspectivas excepcionais. Acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo contribui para a rica troca de ideias e diversidade de pensamentos, que incentivam a inovação e trazem as melhores soluções aos nossos clientes.

Essa filosofia é fundamental para viver os valores da nossa empresa e a nossa responsabilidade de deixar o mundo num lugar melhor. Saiba mais sobre nossa

Nossos programas e iniciativas de treinamento concentram-se no desenvolvimento de ponta a ponta, desde a integração até a liderança sênior. Oferecemos uma gama de oportunidades de desenvolvimento, incluindo treinamento presencial e virtual, além de programas de mentoria.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Auditoria e Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar o planejamento anual de auditorias e o calendário anual de treinamentos da área;
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e controlar a escala de trabalho e folgas das equipes de encarregados e auditores;
  • Apoiar a integração de novos colaboradores e lojistas, contribuindo para a adaptação e entendimento das normas do shopping;
  • Distribuir as lojas e equipes diariamente para a realização do processo de auditoria de fechamento, garantindo cobertura total das operações auditáveis;
  • Consolidar, conferir e validar dados de triangulação de vendas, relatórios semanais e informações operacionais, garantindo precisão e consistência;
  • Acompanhar planos de ação e elaborando notificações formais aos lojistas quando necessário;
  • Apoiar a rotina operacional do shopping por meio de rondas, conferência de pendências, validação de auditorias presenciais e acompanhamento do mapa de risco.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Contábeis, Economia e Afins;
  • Pacote Office Intermediário;
  • Experiência em Excel;
  • Experiência prévia com supervisão ou coordenação de equipes, especialmente equipes operacionais ou de auditoria.

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Finance Project Analyst will act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • As a Project Financial Analyst, you will record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • 1-3 years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para impulsionar a geração de valor a partir de dados na Klavi, atuando na identificação de padrões, tendências e oportunidades de negócio em grandes volumes de informação. Essa pessoa terá papel estratégico na tradução de análises em recomendações acionáveis, apoiando decisões e iniciativas com impacto direto para o negócio e para nossos clientes. Atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de Comercial, Soluções, Produto e Engenharia, contribuindo para a construção de dashboards e visualizações executivas e garantindo a implementação e operacionalização de soluções analíticas e modelos em entregas orientadas ao cliente (features, automações, insights e produtos de dados). O objetivo é fortalecer uma cultura data-driven, com excelência técnica, comunicação clara e foco em resultados.

Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Traduzir análises e resultados em recomendações acionáveis, apoiando decisões estratégicas.
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas como Comercial, Soluções e Produto garantindo alinhamento de objetivos e impacto.
  • Construir e manter visualizações e dashboards executivos para comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a decisão.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento (Git/GitHub), reprodutibilidade e qualidade de código.
  • Atuar de forma próxima ao time de Engenharia, garantindo a implementação e operacionalização de soluções de dados e modelos em entregas orientadas ao cliente (ex.: features, automações, insights e produtos de dados).

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida como Cientista de Dados Sênior ou posição equivalente.
  • 3+ anos de experiência em indústria ou varejo (ou contextos similares de dados em escala).
  • Vivência em análise de mercado, CRM, precificação ou planejamento comercial.
  • Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL para manipulação, análise e modelagem de dados em larga escala.
  • Domínio de estatística descritiva e inferencial aplicada à análise de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade comprovada de transformar dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e influência com stakeholders.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial ou híbrida no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo (na Av. Paulista metrô Brigadeiro) conforme combinado. (Os primeiros 3 meses são presenciais para todos)

Salário

  • Regime: CLT
  • Nível: Senior

Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

Etapas

  • Etapa 1: Avaliação do currículo. Capriche as atividades que você já executou;
  • Etapa 2 : Primeira Conversa com RH sobre a vaga;
  • Etapa 3 : Case Técnico;
  • Etapa 4 : Entrevistas com a área de Dados (provavelmente 3 entrevistas);
  • Etapa 5 : Fase de referência;
  • Etapa 6 : Contratação.

title: Category Manager Jr.
description:

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

  • Apoiar decisões em um ambiente de mercado dinâmico e de alta volatilidade.

  • Apoiar a definição da estratégia da categoria, incluindo portfólio, precificação e posicionamento de mercado.

Requisitos e qualificações:

O que você precisa ter

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em compras, procurement, supply chain ou category management.
  • Vivência com análise de custos, margens, fornecedores e portfólio de produtos.
  • Inglês e espanhol (intermediário a avançado) - será testado em entrevista.

O que gostaríamos que você tivesse

  • Pós-graduação em Supply Chain, Compras, Logística ou áreas afins (desejável).
  • Fundamentos de Category Management e Procurement.
  • Análise de margens, custos, budget e forecast.
  • Estratégias de portfólio e precificação.
  • Conhecimento de ERP, Excel intermediário/avançado e ferramentas de BI (diferencial).

Modelo de Trabalho - CLT 100% Presencial

Local: Av. Angélica - Consolação.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação no Cartão Ifood Benefícios para você gastar como quiser no crédito;
  • Vale Transporte.
  • Plano médico Sul América, sem coparticipação - para você cuidar da sua saúde e da sua família (dependentes diretos).

A Barentz é uma ótima empresa para se trabalhar, com uma cultura organizacional positiva e calorosa e uma mentalidade “Uma equipe, um objetivo”. Somos uma empresa multinacional inspiradora, com segmentos de mercado em rápido crescimento e cobertura global.

title: UX/UI DESIGN
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.

A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.

● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.

● Trabalhar em parceria direta com Estrategistas de CRO, recebendo diagnósticos, pesquisas, copy e direcionamentos que servirão como base para a criação das interfaces.

● Adaptar layouts para desktop e mobile, garantindo hierarquia visual, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário.

● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.

● Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes de diferentes segmentos, como bancos, fintechs, SaaS, e-commerce e geração de leads.

Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:

● Experiência sólida com UI Design, especialmente para sites e landing pages.

● Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e protótipos navegáveis.

● Portfólio online com projetos de UI Design (item indispensável no processo seletivo).

● Boa base em UX/UI Design, com foco em clareza, usabilidade e simplificação de problemas complexos.

● Experiência ou familiaridade com design systems e organização de componentes.

● Capacidade de executar com qualidade a partir de orientações claras, mantendo criatividade, organização e alinhamento com o time.

● Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento com prazos e boa gestão de demandas.

● Boa comunicação e abertura para dar e receber feedbacks.

Diferenciais desejáveis:

● Experiência prévia com projetos de CRO, testes A/B ou otimização de conversão.

● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.

● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.

● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.

We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . title: Analista de importação
description:
Vaga: Analista de Importação

﻿ Quem somos

Somos uma startup de tecnologia em comércio exterior , com o propósito de nos tornarmos a maior plataforma de importação B2B do Brasil — e futuramente, do mundo — oferecendo soluções completas de importação porta a porta .

Diferente de uma multinacional, aqui a cultura é mais dinâmica, com processos em constante evolução, muita autonomia, proximidade direta com o CEO e oportunidades reais de crescimento .

Você se sente à vontade para trabalhar em um ambiente assim, onde as estruturas ainda estão sendo construídas e cada pessoa tem papel ativo no desenvolvimento da empresa?

Resumo da posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Importação para atuar em todas as etapas do processo de importação, desde o sourcing e contato com fornecedores internacionais até a liberação e entrega final da carga no Brasil.

A pessoa ideal para essa posição é organizada, analítica e proativa, com capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas operações simultaneamente e garantir eficiência, segurança e rentabilidade em cada embarque.

Esse cargo é fundamental para a operação e o crescimento da empresa, atuando em parceria com as áreas de logística, financeira, fiscal e comercial para garantir o sucesso das importações.

Responsabilidades

• Pesquisar e avaliar fornecedores internacionais, analisando confiabilidade e condições comerciais.

• Realizar cotações, negociações e acompanhamento de pedidos de compra no exterior.

• Agendar embarques e atuar junto a agentes de carga, garantindo prazos e custos competitivos.

• Conferir e validar documentos de importação (Invoice, Packing List, BL e demais).

• Enviar informações e documentos ao despachante aduaneiro e acompanhar a liberação da carga junto à Receita Federal e órgãos anuentes.

• Coordenar a retirada e o transporte da carga até o destino final, alinhando com transportadoras e terminais.

• Elaborar planilhas de custos completas por operação, considerando frete, seguro, impostos e despesas locais.

• Calcular o custo unitário dos produtos importados, aplicando tributos (II, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ICMS) e benefícios fiscais estaduais.

• Analisar benefícios fiscais de ICMS, especialmente os incentivos dos estados de Santa Catarina e Rondônia.

• Criar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para controle de prazos, custos e performance operacional.

Qualificações

• Experiência comprovada de pelo menos 3 anos em processos de importação ponta a ponta .

• Domínio de Excel avançado (planilhas de custos e simulações financeiras).

• Conhecimento sólido em regimes fiscais estaduais de ICMS aplicados à importação.

• Perfil analítico, detalhista e organizado, com habilidade de negociação e resolução de problemas.

• Formação desejável: Administração, Comércio Exterior, Logística ou áreas correlatas.

• Idioma: Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação com fornecedores internacionais).

Como será o sucesso nesse cargo

Ter sucesso nessa função significa ser capaz de garantir o fluxo completo da importação com previsibilidade e controle de custos , antecipar riscos e oportunidades, negociar com eficiência e assegurar que cada embarque seja executado dentro do prazo e da margem esperada.

O que oferecemos

• Ambiente dinâmico e inovador, com integração entre tecnologia e comércio exterior.

• Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em plena expansão internacional.

• Pacote de benefícios competitivo.

• Participação em projetos estratégicos e operações de importação de grande porte.

title: Angular Developer
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.

About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

• Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs

The Ideal candidate

• A minimum of five years of front-end development experience in the capital markets

• Advanced experience in building complex applications in Angular (version 15+)

• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS, and SCSS

• Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, ES6, and RxJS

• Familiarity with Redux/NGRX-5

• Hands-on experience with automated testing, particularly using Jest

• Experience working with NX Monorepo

• Good interpersonal and communication skills, with professional English proficiency

Why should you join Phi Partners

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Analista de Contratos Bilíngue
description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Desejável inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;

Somos uma instituição que respeita e valoriza a diversidade humana, e proporcionamos um ambiente ético, desafiador, dinâmico, aberto ao diálogo, à construção coletiva e à aprendizagem contínua. Se esses valores são relevantes para você, junte-se ao nosso time!

title: React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

Step into the world of frontend excellence as our React Developer, where you'll craft stunning user interfaces and functionality for innovative web applications. This isn't just about coding - it's about creating immersive digital experiences that delight users while collaborating with elite professionals across various cutting-edge industries.

Key responsibilities:

- Design and implement responsive user interfaces using React.js.

- Develop reusable components and libraries for future use.

- Transform UI/UX designs into high-quality, functional code.

- Optimize application performance and responsiveness.

- Collaborate with backend developers to integrate frontend with API services.

- Participate in code reviews and implement best practices.

- Stay at the forefront of emerging trends and technologies in frontend development.

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

Requirements:

- 3+ years of experience with React.js and JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Strong understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

- Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Context API, MobX).

- Knowledge of modern frontend build tools and workflows.

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration patterns.

- Experience with responsive design and cross-browser compatibility.

- Understanding of UI/UX design principles.

- Ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

- Advanced English proficiency.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.


Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!


We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Workspaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.


You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About NIIT


NIIT is a leading Skills and Talent Development Corporation that is building a manpower pool for global industry requirements. The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.


Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -

Position: Training Coordinator


We are looking for our next training operations coordinator. This role is part of the Operations team and supports NIIT’s customer(s) in Frankfurt.

to deliver outstanding service.

We all work together on a common project with part of the team based in India.

As a training operations coordinator, you will be reporting to the training operations manager.

You will be the key contact point for all local stakeholders, coordinating training session delivery. You will master and oversee all activities within the service.

You will work closely and in partnership with the customer’s learning delivery team.


Roles & Responsibility:


  • Analyze the training needs provided by the Client and determine the number of sessions needed to train the overall number of trainees according to courses and per site,
  • Initiate and manage requests for session creation, modification, completion, and cancellation where required,
  • Organize the training sessions according to trainees’ expectations and availability and ensure their proper execution,
  • Calibrate and coordinate with the Indian team for any changes/updates in the training event/program,
  • Support completion of training activities by following up for attendance and invoice if required,
  • Follow and ensure adherence to the workflow and processes using the CRM tool
  • Ensure Learner Support Level 2


Experience & Skill:


  • 2 to 4 years of experience in learning delivery management and/or operations,
  • Exposure to an international work environment
  • High-level understanding of the training landscape
  • Customer service-oriented posture is a must
  • Team player
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concise thoughts
  • Attention to detail, structured and organized, capable of prioritizing activities
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or any other CRM
  • Knowledge of Cornerstone or any other LMS is an added advantage
  • Fluent in English is a mandatory requirement
  • Proficient in MS Office, Excel, SharePoint


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Especialista Salesforce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.
